memories.title: Reviewed memory gate
memories.summary: Agents can only propose long-term memories; users accept or reject them in the review workbench.
memories.content: The memory architecture protects durable long-term memory with a review gate. Agent tools create pending proposals and cannot directly accept, overwrite, purge, or resolve memory conflicts.

memories.title: Canvas card editing
memories.summary: Users can move cards on the capture board.
memories.content: Dragging a card updates position without refreshing its knowledge item.

memories.title: Capability scoped ContextPack
memories.summary: ContextPack retrieval enforces scope, capability, privacy, citations, and token budgets.
memories.content: External agents read bounded ContextPack payloads instead of dumping the full database. The composer filters slices by task scope, visibility, privacy labels, explicit capabilities, and max character budget.

memories.title: Export bundle
memories.summary: Export writes durable records and omits rebuildable projections.
memories.content: SQLite FTS can be rebuilt from durable knowledge items and is not treated as primary memory.

memories.title: Cross-agent rolling digest
memories.summary: Older task events are compressed into TaskDigest while original TaskEvent rows remain durable.
memories.content: Handoff packs include current state, recent task events, checkpoints, refs, and a rolling TaskDigest for older work. The digest is a rebuildable projection and does not replace source evidence.

memories.title: Profile temporal graph
memories.summary: Profile facts can be superseded or invalidated over time.
memories.content: Dynamic facts use status, valid_at, invalid_at, supersession, and conflict records.

memories.title: ContextPack budget pressure trace
memories.summary: Selection trace must show selected items and budget pressure.
memories.content: ContextPack budget pressure trace keeps the critical memory short enough to fit while other verbose candidates are truncated by maxChars.

memories.title: Duplicate source primary memory
memories.summary: Primary memory should survive duplicate source dedupe.
memories.content: ContextPack duplicate source trace should keep the primary reviewed item and dedupe the shadow item that points to the same source evidence.

memories.title: Duplicate source shadow memory
memories.summary: Shadow memory should be deduped by source evidence.
memories.content: ContextPack duplicate source trace shadow copy should not consume extra ContextPack budget when the same source evidence is already represented.

memories.title: Workspace scope memory
memories.summary: Workspace scoped memory is visible for the query.
memories.content: ContextPack wrong scope trace should return this workspace-safe memory.

memories.title: Other task scoped memory
memories.summary: Other task memory must be filtered without leaking content.
memories.content: ContextPack wrong scope trace private task content should not be returned in a workspace query.
